articles.title: Morning Brief Podcast: What Went Wrong With India's Most Reliable Rocket?
articles.summary: India's highly trusted PSLV rocket has faced unprecedented back-to-back failures in May 2025 and January 2026. These setbacks, unusual for a vehicle with a 92% success rate over three decades, involved mysterious third-stage anomalies in both incidents. This development highlights a critical technical challenge for ISRO, requiring urgent investigation into the causes of these rare operational disruptions for India's premier satellite launcher.

articles.title: Harvard Student Exposes ‘Systematic’ Liberal Bias Among Faculty Members
articles.summary: A Harvard student has raised concerns about widespread liberal bias among campus faculty, asserting it is coordinated. This comes after Harvard President Alan Garber acknowledged the university's missteps regarding faculty conduct. The student's revelations highlight ongoing debates about academic neutrality and political influence within prestigious educational institutions, sparking broader discussions on campus freedoms and intellectual diversity.
